finding_summary: NL gemeente x oprichtingen x SBI table DOES NOT EXIST in CBS Open Data as of 2026-06-16.
gemeente_births_verdict: BLOCKED — No CBS Open Data table provides oprichtingen (births/openings) at gemeente x SBI x jaar resolution.
available_at_gemeente: establishment STOCK (81575NED: 483 gemeenten x SBI x 2007-2026)

european_netherlands_filter.note: Caribbean NL (BES) uses different statistical system. CBS 83631NED and 81575NED cover European Netherlands only. No BES codes appear in RegioS dimensions.

municipal_boundary_changes: Significant. NL has ~100+ municipal mergers since 2007. 483 GM codes in 81575NED reflect historical municipalities. In 2023 approximately 342 European municipalities exist after mergers. Time-consistent panel requires concordance tables.

sbi_to_a10_mapping.note: 81575NED uses SBI section-level codes (A-U, 20 codes), same as HERALD A10 except: A10 is section-level already. Mapping is direct for sections G,H,I→GI; B+C+D+E→BE; M+N→MN; O+P+Q→OQ; R+S→RU. K and L separate in 81575NED.

alternative_sources: CBS Microdata (remote access required): may have gemeente x oprichtingen x SBI but not via Open Data API.
Eurostat BD_HGNACE_R: covers NL at NUTS3 (COROP) level, 2007-2022, no gemeente.
KvK Kamer van Koophandel: commercial company register, not via open API.
Attention: no alternative CBS open API table found with gemeente x births x SBI.
recommended_path: CBS Microdata access (remote via CBS Research Center) or aggregate COROP stays at current resolution.
risks: CBS statistical disclosure suppression: for small municipalities, cell counts suppressed (privacy)
